[s0l0!-header][h1]Matplotlib[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Matplotlib[/b] is a library used to create graphs, charts, and figures. It also provides functions to customize your figures by changing the colors, labels, etc.

To start using [b]matplotlib[/b], we first need to import it:[code format="py" ]import matplotlib.pyplot as plt [/code]
[b]pyplot[/b] is the module we will be using to create our plots.
[note][b]plt[/b] is a common name used for importing this module.[/note]

要开始使用**Matplotlib**，我们首先需要导入它：
content.text_html:
Matplotlib is a library used to create graphs, charts, and figures. It also provides functions to customize your figures by changing the colors, labels, etc.

To start using matplotlib, we first need to import it:

Matplotlib是一个用于创建图形、图表和数字的库。它还提供了通过改变颜色、标签等来定制数字的功能。

要开始使用matplotlib，我们首先需要导入它。

pyplot is the module we will be using to create our plots.

pyplot是我们将用来创建我们的绘图的模块。

resolved.title: Matplotlib
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Matplotlib[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Matplotlib[/b] works really well with [b]Pandas[/b]!
To demonstrate the power of [b]matplotlib[/b], let's create a chart from dummy data.
We will create a pandas [b]Series[/b] with some numbers and use it to create our chart:[code format="py" codeId="3241"]s = pd.Series([18, 42, 9, 32, 81, 64, 3])

s.plot(kind='bar')
plt.savefig('plot.png') [/code]
The .[b]plot()[/b] function is used to create a plot from the data in a Pandas Series or DataFrame.

Here is the result:[img id="4560" width="100%"]
The data from the series is using the Y axis, while the index is plotted on the X axis. 
As we have not provided a custom index for our data, the default numeric index is used.
[note][b]plt.savefig('plot.png')[/b] is used to save and display the chart in our [b]Code Playground[/b].
In most environments this step is not needed, as calling the [b]plot[/b]() function automatically displays the chart. [/note]

content.text:
**Matplotlib**通常与**Pandas**库一起使用!
为了展示**matplotlib**的强大功能，让我们用假数据创建一个图表。

首先用创建一个pandas 数字 **Series**，并用它来创建图表：
content.text_html:
Matplotlib works really well with Pandas! To demonstrate the power of matplotlib, let's create a chart from dummy data. We will create a pandas Series with some numbers and use it to create our chart:

Matplotlib与Pandas合作得非常好! 为了展示matplotlib的强大功能，让我们用假数据创建一个图表。 我们将用一些数字创建一个pandas Series，并使用它来创建我们的图表。

content.content:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd

s = pd.Series([18, 42, 9, 32, 81, 64, 3])
s.plot(kind='bar')
plt.savefig('output/plot.png')

content.text:
`.plot()`函数用于从Pandas的系列Series或数据框架DataFrame中的数据来绘制图表。

结果如下：
content.text_html:
The .plot() function is used to create a plot from the data in a Pandas Series or DataFrame.

Here is the result:

.**plot()**函数用于从Pandas系列或数据框架中的数据创建一个绘图。

下面是结果。

content.text:
系列(series)的数据展示在Y轴，而指数(下标)则绘制在X轴上。
由于我们没有为数据提供一个自定义的指数，所以使用了默认的数字指数。
content.text_html:
The data from the series is using the Y axis, while the index is plotted on the X axis. As we have not provided a custom index for our data, the default numeric index is used.

系列的数据使用Y轴，而指数则绘制在X轴上。 由于我们没有为我们的数据提供一个自定义的指数，所以使用了默认的数字指数。

content.text:
`plt.savefig('/output/plot.png')`用于保存绘制的图表。
在大多数环境中不需要这一步，因为调用`plot()`函数会自动显示图表。
content.text_html:
plt.savefig('plot.png') is used to save and display the chart in our Code Playground. In most environments this step is not needed, as calling the plot() function automatically displays the chart.

plt.savefig('plot.png')用于保存并在我们的Code Playground中显示该图表。 在大多数环境中不需要这一步，因为调用plot()函数会自动显示图表。
